title: Improving Crafts!
description: Enhance your survival with craftable Elytras, Totems, and Netherite. Recyle gear and skip the grind in 1.21.1!
body:
🛠️ Survival Tweaks & Easy Recipes (Hotfix)

Tired of grindy mechanics and losing items? This datapack brings essential recipes and balance changes to make your Minecraft 1.21.1 experience smoother and more fun.
✨ Key Features:

    Ultimate Crafting: Craft previously uncraftable items like Elytras, Totems of Undying, and Enchanted Golden Apples.

    Netherite Simplified: No more hunting for upgrade templates! Craft Netherite gear directly in the crafting table.

    Resource Recycling: Use the Stonecutter to dismantle iron/gold tools and armor back into ingots. Even horse armor can be recycled!

    Easy Materials: * Smelt Rotten Flesh into Leather.

        Craft Name Tags, Saddles, and even Cobwebs.

        Turn Poisonous Potatoes into something useful (Bonemeal/Normal Potatoes).

    Woodcutting: Use the Stonecutter for all wood types to get planks and stairs faster.

🚀 Installation:

    Download the zip file.

    Drop it into your world's datapacks folder.

    Type /reload in-game.

📝 Note:

This pack is designed for players who prefer a faster-paced survival experience without the tedious grind. Enjoy!
